methodology: Exact baseline src extracted using git archive, compared against final source. Three sequential sessions, five warmups and 30 warm runs, 20 independent committed graph/history starts per session. Node monotonic timing excludes browser paint and is supplementary to original pre-edit baseline. Treatment ordering is all-before then all-after, not randomized; no significance claim.
